knowledge:
- key_parameters: enzymeCut=Logical indicating whether to simulate enzymatic fragmentation (which can cause chimeric read pairs to map to the exact same location) ;; chimericProp=Proportion of artificial chimeric fragments to simulate ;; sameChrProp=Proportion of artifact chimeric fragments derived from the same chromosome ;; adjChimProp=Proportion of adjacent ss-DNA combinations among same chromosomal ss-DNA combinations ;; sameStrandProb=Proportion of same-strand ss-DNA combinations among adjacent ss-DNA combinations ;; spikeWidth=The width of the chimeric read spike used in simulating distant ss-DNA combinations ;; highNoiseRate=The noise rate for each base in noisy reads ;; highNoiseProb=The proportion of highly noisy reads ;; coverage=The desired sequencing coverage depth ;; readLen=The length of the simulated reads
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to generate realistic synthetic NGS datasets representing FFPE samples to benchmark structural variant callers, alignment algorithms, or artifact filtering pipelines.
- pitfalls: Ensure that the target regions DataFrame has exactly three columns representing chromosome, start position, and end position using 1-based coordinates. Ensure the Phred score profile matrix matches the desired read length (e.g., using a 150bp profile for 150bp reads) to avoid simulation errors or unrealistic quality scores.

workflows.name: genome_wide_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate FFPE NGS reads across whole genomes, chromosomes, or large genomic regions.
input: example.bam (User's BAM file to estimate Phred profile)
regionsBam.txt (Target regions for BAM profile estimation)
workflows.stages: 1. Estimate Phred score profile from a BAM file ;; 2. Load reference genome sequences ;; 3. Simulate reads using readSimFFPE
workflows.code:
bamFilePath <- system.file("extdata", "example.bam", package = "SimFFPE")
regionPath <- system.file("extdata", "regionsBam.txt", package = "SimFFPE")
regions <- read.table(regionPath)
PhredScoreProfile <- calcPhredScoreProfile(bamFilePath, targetRegions = regions)

referencePath <- system.file("extdata", "example.fasta", package = "SimFFPE")
reference <- readDNAStringSet(referencePath)

sourceSeq <- reference[1:3]

workflows.name: targeted_region_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate FFPE NGS reads for specific targeted regions or whole exome panels.
workflows.stages: 1. Load target regions ;; 2. Load Phred score profile ;; 3. Simulate targeted reads using targetReadSimFFPE
workflows.code:
PhredScoreProfilePath <- system.file("extdata", "PhredScoreProfile1.txt",
                                      package = "SimFFPE")
PhredScoreProfile <- as.matrix(read.table(PhredScoreProfilePath, skip = 1))
colnames(PhredScoreProfile)  <- 
    strsplit(readLines(PhredScoreProfilePath)[1], "\t")[[1]]

referencePath <- system.file("extdata", "example.fasta", package = "SimFFPE")
regionPath <- system.file("extdata", "regionsSim.txt", package = "SimFFPE")
targetRegions <- read.table(regionPath)

outFile3 <- paste0(tempdir(), "/sim3")
targetReadSimFFPE(referencePath, PhredScoreProfile, targetRegions, outFile3,
                  coverage = 120, readLen = 100, meanInsertLen = 180, 
                  sdInsertLen = 50, enzymeCut = FALSE)
